title: Human papillomavirus 16 immortalization of normal human ectocervical epithelial cells alters retinoic acid regulation of cell growth and epidermal growth factor receptor expression.

title: CD66+ cells in cervical precancers are partially differentiated progenitors with neoplastic traits.

evidence_summary: Recombinant TGF-beta2 treatment rescued TGF-beta-responsive gene expression, inhibited growth, and decreased immortalization in E6/E7-expressing cervical keratinocytes, confirming tumor suppressor role.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HPV-16 E6 and E7 decreased TGF-beta2 mRNA and secreted active TGF-beta2 in differentiating cervical keratinocytes; recombinant TGF-beta2 (10-200 pg/ml) restored expression of TGF-beta-responsive genes, inhibited cell growth, and decreased immortalization by E6 and E7.

title: Human papillomavirus type 16 E6 and E7 proteins inhibit differentiation-dependent expression of transforming growth factor-beta2 in cervical keratinocytes.
Cell-mediated immunological responses in cervical and vaginal cancer patients immunized with a lipidated epitope of human papillomavirus type 16 E7.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: FMdC treatment in colon (WiDr) and cervical (C33-A, SiHa) cancer cell lines inhibited ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase, depleted dATP, induced S-phase arrest, enhanced radiation-induced G2-M block, and achieved radiosensitization with ER(2Gy) up to 3.5.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: FMdC inhibited ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase, resulting in dATP depletion, S-phase accumulation, enhanced G2-M block after irradiation, and radiosensitization of WiDr, C33-A, and SiHa cells.

title: The ribonucleoside diphosphate reductase inhibitor (E)-2'-deoxy-(fluoromethylene)cytidine as a cytotoxic radiosensitizer in vitro.

evidence_summary: Anti-IL1RAP antibody treatment abrogated tumor-induced neutrophil expansion and combined with HPV16 E7 peptide vaccine to elicit an effective antitumor immune response in HPV16-driven cervical tumor mouse models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Blockade of IL1RAP with an antagonist antibody reversed systemic neutrophil expansion and restored efficacy of a therapeutic HPV16 E7 peptide vaccine.

title: HPV16-Expressing Tumors Release Multiple IL1 Ligands to Orchestrate Systemic Immunosuppression Whose Disruption Enables Efficacy of a Therapeutic Vaccine.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Long-term ethidium bromide exposure generated subclones devoid of mitochondrial DNA; tumor-forming capacity was tested by subcutaneous and intramuscular implantation in athymic nude mice, showing mtDNA-less cells still form tumors intramuscularly.

title: Tumor-forming ability in athymic nude mice of human cell lines devoid of mitochondrial DNA.
Cellular pharmacology of novel C8-linked anthramycin-based sequence-selective DNA minor groove cross-linking agents.

evidence_summary: Pretreatment of HeLa cervical carcinoma cells with EGF or TGF-alpha increased cisplatin sensitivity by 2-4 fold and enhanced platinum uptake; phorbol ester PKC activation also sensitized, while bryostatin I blocked phorbol ester but not EGF-mediated sensitization, indicating distinct signaling pathways.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: 24-hr pretreatment with EGF (10 ng/ml) increased cisplatin anti-proliferative activity by 2-4 fold in HeLa cells and enhanced [195mPt]cisplatin uptake without affecting efflux; bryostatin I did not block EGF-induced platinum accumulation.
24-hr pretreatment with transforming growth factor-alpha increased cisplatin anti-proliferative activity by 2-4 fold in HeLa cells.

Phorbol 12,13-dibutyrate (PKC activator) sensitized HeLa cells to cisplatin and increased platinum uptake; bryostatin I (PKC partial agonist) reversed phorbol ester-mediated sensitization and platinum content increase, but not EGF effects.

title: Comparison of effects of growth factors and protein kinase C activators on cellular sensitivity to cis-diamminedichloroplatinum(II).

evidence_summary: Mutated HPV16 LCRs with deletions/point mutations of YY1-binding sites cloned into luciferase reporter vectors showed up to 6.5-fold increased promoter activity, confirming the repressive function of YY1 binding.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Deletion or point mutations of YY1-binding sites in the HPV16 long control region led to 5.5- to 6.5-fold increased luciferase expression in reporter assays, indicating loss of YY1-mediated repression enhances viral oncogene promoter activity.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: patient-derived HPV16 episomal DNA from primary cervical tumors and lymph node metastases, luciferase reporter in vitro

title: Prevalence of deletions of YY1-binding sites in episomal HPV 16 DNA from cervical cancers.

evidence_summary: Adenovirus vector-based prime-boost vaccination (IM prime, Ivag boost) in mice induced cervicovaginal CD8+ T cells producing IFN-γ and TNF-α against HPV16 oncoproteins and expressing tissue-resident markers CD69 and CD103.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Prime-boost vaccination with adenoviral vectors expressing a fusion of HPV16 E6 and E7 induced E6-specific CD8+ T cell responses in the cervicovaginal tract of mice.
Prime-boost vaccination with adenoviral vectors expressing a fusion of HPV16 E6 and E7 induced E7-specific CD8+ T cell responses in the cervicovaginal tract of mice.

title: Adenovirus vector-based prime-boost vaccination via heterologous routes induces cervicovaginal CD8<sup>+</sup> T cell responses against HPV16 oncoproteins.

evidence_summary: TriCurin treatment upregulated TP53 mRNA and suppressed HPV16 E6/E7 transcripts in W12 cervical precancer cells; MTT assay confirmed growth inhibition.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: TriCurin treatment activated TP53 mRNA expression in W12 cells at 24h as measured by RT-PCR.

title: A novel cancer preventative botanical mixture, TriCurin, inhibits viral transcripts and the growth of W12 cervical cells harbouring extrachromosomal or integrated HPV16 DNA.

evidence_summary: Overexpression of HNF1 significantly increased human IGFBP-1 promoter activity in C33 cells, demonstrating its functional role in regulating IGFBP-1 transcription.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Cotransfection of HNF1 expression vector with IGFBP-1 promoter-reporter in C33 cells increased promoter activity 6-fold; mutation of the HNF1 binding site abolished this effect.

title: Liver-specific expression of human insulin-like growth factor binding protein 1: functional role of transcription factor HNF1 in vivo.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Tumors harboring ERBB2 domain mutations were significantly more sensitive to single agents afatinib or neratinib compared to wild-type tumors in vitro and in vivo.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: primary cervical cancer cell lines and xenografts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: PIK3CA-mutated tumors showed limited single-agent activity to pan-HER or PIK3CA inhibitors but were highly sensitive to the combination of copanlisib and neratinib, resulting in synergistic tumor regression.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: primary cervical cancer cell lines and xenografts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Combination of neratinib and copanlisib was synergistic and induced long-lasting regression of xenografts harboring alterations in the ERBB2/PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.

title: Whole-exome sequencing of cervical carcinomas identifies activating ERBB2 and PIK3CA mutations as targets for combination therapy.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: Copper chelator combined with cisplatin increased cisplatin-DNA adducts and impaired angiogenesis in a mouse model of human cervical cancer, and enhanced killing of cultured cervical and ovarian cancer cells, validating CTR1 as a therapeutic target.
validation_methods: mouse model of human cervical cancer

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Low CTR1 mRNA in ovarian tumors associated with poor platinum response; copper chelator enhanced cisplatin-DNA adducts and tumor cell killing in mouse model of cervical cancer and cultured cells, identifying the copper transporter as a target to improve platinum therapy.

title: Enhancing tumor-specific uptake of the anticancer drug cisplatin with a copper chelator.

evidence_summary: Retroviral expression of HPV16 E6 and E7 in primary human foreskin keratinocytes downregulated angiogenesis inhibitors thrombospondin-1 and maspin, and upregulated angiogenesis inducers interleukin-8 and VEGF, as measured by gene array, RT-PCR, ELISA, and Western blot.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Expression of HPV16 E6/E7 in primary keratinocytes led to decreased thrombospondin-1 levels, detected by gene array, RT-PCR, ELISA, and Western blot.
Maspin expression was reduced in keratinocytes expressing HPV16 E6/E7, confirmed by gene array, RT-PCR, ELISA, and Western blot.
Interleukin-8 was increased in keratinocytes expressing HPV16 E6/E7, validated by gene array, RT-PCR, ELISA, and Western blot.
VEGF (including splice variants 121, 145, 165, 189) was upregulated in keratinocytes expressing HPV16 E6/E7, as shown by gene array, RT-PCR, ELISA, and Western blot.

title: Expression of human papillomavirus type 16 E6 and E7 oncoproteins in primary foreskin keratinocytes is sufficient to alter the expression of angiogenic factors.

evidence_summary: Transfection of connexin 26 (GJB2) or connexin 43 (GJA1) into HPV-positive cervical tumor cell lines restored functional gap junction membrane plaques and intercellular dye transfer, confirming their role in gap junction communication.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Transfection with connexin 26 (GJB2) led to functional gap junction membrane plaques and restored dye coupling in cervical tumor cell lines.
Transfection with connexin 43 (GJA1) led to functional gap junction membrane plaques and restored dye coupling in cervical tumor cell lines.

title: The relationship between connexins, gap junctions, tissue architecture and tumour invasion, as studied in a novel in vitro model of HPV-16-associated cervical cancer progression.

evidence_summary: Stable transduction of folate receptor cDNA in sense orientation increased thymidine kinase activity, augmented AZT phosphorylation and cytotoxicity, and conferred methotrexate resistance, which was reversed by AZT.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Folate receptor overexpression via sense cDNA transduction increased thymidine kinase activity, enhanced AZT phosphorylation and cytotoxicity, and conferred methotrexate resistance that was reversed by AZT.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: HeLa-IU1 cells, in vivo animal model

title: Modulation of the cytotoxicity of 3'-azido-3'-deoxythymidine and methotrexate after transduction of folate receptor cDNA into human cervical carcinoma: identification of a correlation between folate receptor expression and thymidine kinase activity.

evidence_summary: Transient transfection of a plasmid containing a 95-bp DQB enhancer sequence showed cell-type-specific enhancer activity in Raji (Burkitt lymphoma) cells but not in Jurkat (T-cell leukemia) or HeLa (cervical carcinoma) cells; deletion analysis demonstrated that both X and Y box sequences are essential for full enhancer activity.
title: B-cell-specific enhancer activity of conserved upstream elements of the class II major histocompatibility complex DQB gene.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: Overexpression of HPV-18 E6*I in cervical cancer-derived cell lines increased p53 protein during G2/M, reduced E6 in insoluble fractions, and E6 levels were restored by proteasome inhibitor, demonstrating modulation of E6 functions.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of E6*I in cervical cancer cell lines increased p53 protein expression specifically during G2/M phase, counteracting E6-mediated degradation.

title: HPV-18 E6*I modulates HPV-18 full-length E6 functions in a cell cycle dependent manner.

evidence_summary: shRNA-mediated NME1 knockdown in SiHa cervical cancer cells increased lipocalin 2 promoter activity and expression, and decreased migration and invasion, validating NME1's pro-metastatic role.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: shRNA knockdown of NME1 in SiHa cells increased lipocalin 2 promoter activity and expression, decreased cell migration and invasion.

title: Implication of human nonmetastatic clone 23 Type 1 and its downstream gene lipocalin 2 in metastasis and patient's survival of cancer of uterine cervix.

evidence_summary: Adenoviral transfection of p53 in cervical cancer cell lines altered p21WAF1 and pRb expression, leading to G1 arrest and apoptosis, validating p53-dependent tumor suppression.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Transfection with a p53 expressing adenovirus induced G1 arrest and apoptosis in cervical cancer cell lines, confirming its tumor-suppressive function.
p21WAF1 protein level increased at 24 h post p53 adenovirus transfection, associated with G1 arrest, then decreased gradually up to 48 h as apoptosis occurred.
Phosphorylation of pRb was inhibited early post transfection, followed by cleavage, indicating its role in p53-dependent apoptosis.

title: Changes in p21WAF1, pRb, Mdm-2, Bax and Bcl-2 expression in cervical cancer cell lines transfected with a p53 expressing adenovirus.

evidence_summary: HPV16 DNA co-transfection with pSV2neo into C127 mouse fibroblasts followed by G418 selection and soft agar colony assay validated transformation, and nude mouse tumorigenicity confirmed in vivo tumor formation with stable viral DNA integration and transcript expression.
title: Transformation of C127 mouse fibroblasts by human papillomavirus 16.

evidence_summary: HPV-16 E5 overexpression in cervical cells upregulated plasma membrane caveolin-1, dependent on E5 C-terminal amino acids, providing potential therapeutic targets.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HPV-16 E5 oncoprotein expression increased caveolin-1 plasma membrane localization in cervical cells, while mutant E5 did not.

title: HPV-16 E5 oncoprotein upregulates lipid raft components caveolin-1 and ganglioside GM1 at the plasma membrane of cervical cells.

evidence_summary: Single low-dose immunizations with mRNA-LNP vaccines encoding HPV16 E7 fusion protein (gDE7) induced E7-specific CD8+ T cell responses and eradicated subcutaneous and orthotopic HPV-associated tumors in mice.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Vaccination with gDE7 mRNA-LNP induced E7-specific CD8+ T cells, generated memory responses preventing tumor relapses, and eradicated established tumors in mouse models.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: subcutaneous and orthotopic mouse tumor models

title: Single immunizations of self-amplifying or non-replicating mRNA-LNP vaccines control HPV-associated tumors in mice.

evidence_summary: DFMO treatment in patients with cervical intraepithelial neoplasia down-regulated EGFR expression away from basal layer in responders, and pretreatment EGFR levels predicted response.
disease: Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia and invasive cervical cancer

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Immunohistochemical staining showed EGFR spatial dysregulation with progression, and DFMO treatment reversed EGFR expression expansion in responders; pretreatment EGFR levels predicted treatment response.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: archival cervical cone biopsies and pretreatment/posttreatment cervical biopsies from patients with CIN

title: Epidermal growth factor receptor expression in cervical intraepithelial neoplasia and its modulation during an alpha-difluoromethylornithine chemoprevention trial.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Doxycycline-inducible repression of HPV-16 E7 in Bi-L E7/K5-tTA bitransgenic mice caused regression of high-grade cervical dysplasia and established cervical tumors, confirming that continuous E7 expression is required for lesion persistence.
disease: cervical cancer and high-grade cervical dysplasia

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Repression of HPV-16 E7 via doxycycline treatment in transgenic mice led to regression of high-grade cervical dysplasia and established tumors, demonstrating its requirement for persistence.

title: Persistence of high-grade cervical dysplasia and cervical cancer requires the continuous expression of the human papillomavirus type 16 E7 oncogene.

evidence_summary: Demonstrated PI3K/AKT activation-induced PTEN ubiquitination and degradation dependent on MKRN1 E3 ligase; AKT phosphorylates and stabilizes MKRN1; low PTEN protein correlates with high pAKT/MKRN1 and poor survival in cervical cancer.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: PTEN protein is destabilized via ubiquitination and degradation upon PI3K/AKT activation, and its low expression correlates with poor prognosis.
MKRN1 is required for PTEN ubiquitination and degradation; its stabilization is mediated by AKT phosphorylation, and high MKRN1 expression correlates with low PTEN and poor survival.
Activation of PI3K/AKT signaling induces PTEN ubiquitination and degradation, forming a positive feedback loop to enhance tumorigenesis.

title: PI3K/AKT activation induces PTEN ubiquitination and destabilization accelerating tumourigenesis.

evidence_summary: Mutant ubiquitin and HPV E6 oncoprotein were used in in vitro and cell-based ubiquitination assays to demonstrate that E6AP activity is regulated by noncovalent ubiquitin interactions and allosteric activation by E6, with Ring1B as substrate.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HPV E6 oncoprotein rescues full-length E6AP's disability to use ubiquitin hydrophobic patch mutant for ubiquitination and stimulates E6AP-mediated ubiquitination of Ring1B in vitro and in cells.

title: Role of ubiquitin and the HPV E6 oncoprotein in E6AP-mediated ubiquitination.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HDAC inhibitors sodium butyrate and trichostatin A upregulated CDKN1A (p21CIP1) in HPV-positive cervical carcinoma cells.
HDAC inhibitor treatment increased CDKN1B (p27KIP1) protein levels, which correlated with downregulation of SKP2.
Complete loss of CDK2 kinase activity was observed after HDAC inhibition, despite ongoing viral transcription.
Downregulation of SKP2 (p45SKP2) was detected following HDAC inhibitor treatment, contributing to p27KIP1 stabilization.
HDAC inhibition triggered E7-dependent degradation of RB1 (pRb), while E2F levels remained unaffected.

title: Inhibitors of histone deacetylase arrest cell cycle and induce apoptosis in cervical carcinoma cells circumventing human papillomavirus oncogene expression.

evidence_summary: Allogeneic T-cell lines stimulated with HPV18-positive, CD80 and HLA-A*0201 transfected cervical cancer cells identified a naturally processed HPV18 E7 epitope; epitope-specific T cells exhibited cytolytic activity against peptide-pulsed and tumor targets and produced IFN-gamma in ELISpot assays, with in vivo relevance confirmed in tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes of a cervical cancer patient.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Stimulation of allogeneic T cells with HPV18-positive cervical cancer cells led to identification of an immunogenic HLA-A*0201-restricted epitope; epitope-specific T cells lysed peptide-pulsed targets and HPV18-transformed tumor cells, and released IFN-gamma.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: HPV18-positive, CD80 and HLA-A*0201 transfected cervical cancer cells; autologous peptide-pulsed targets; HPV18 transformed tumor cells; tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes from a HLA-matched cervical cancer patient

title: Identification of a naturally processed HLA-A*0201 HPV18 E7 T cell epitope by tumor cell mediated in vitro vaccination.

evidence_summary: EGF treatment in HPV16-immortalized cervical epithelial cells (ECE16-1) dose-dependently suppressed IGFBP-3 protein and mRNA levels, independent of mitogenic effects, thereby potentiating IGF-I-stimulated proliferation; tumorigenic cell lines showed lower IGFBP-3.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: EGF treatment reduced IGFBP-3 protein and mRNA levels; TGF-beta co-treatment uncoupled IGFBP-3 suppression from growth; lower IGFBP-3 in tumorigenic vs nontumorigenic lines enhanced IGF-I response.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: ECE16-1 (HPV16-immortalized cervical epithelial cells), HPV16-positive tumorigenic and nontumorigenic cell lines

title: Epidermal growth factor suppresses insulin-like growth factor binding protein 3 levels in human papillomavirus type 16-immortalized cervical epithelial cells and thereby potentiates the effects of insulin-like growth factor 1.

evidence_summary: HPV16 E7 knockout in K14-HPV16 transgenic mice reduced LDHA nuclear translocation and H3K79 tri-methylation, validating nuclear LDHA's role in HPV-induced cervical tumor growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HPV16 E7 knockout in K14-HPV16 transgenic mice reduced LDHA nuclear translocation and DOT1L-mediated histone H3K79 tri-methylation, confirming nuclear LDHA's non-canonical enzyme activity promotes antioxidant responses and Wnt signaling for tumor growth.

title: Nuclear lactate dehydrogenase A senses ROS to produce α-hydroxybutyrate for HPV-induced cervical tumor growth.

evidence_summary: YC-1 treatment in xenograft models of multiple cancer types reduced HIF-1α protein levels, tumor vascularity, and HIF-1-inducible gene expression, and inhibited tumor growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: YC-1 treatment in mouse xenografts reduced HIF-1α protein levels and downstream targets, correlating with reduced vascularity and tumor growth inhibition.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: immunodeficient mice bearing Hep3B, NCI-H87, Caki-1, SiHa, or SK-N-MC xenografts

title: YC-1: a potential anticancer drug targeting hypoxia-inducible factor 1.
journal: Journal of the National Cancer Institute

evidence_summary: Anti-PLAP immunotoxin specifically killed PLAP-expressing cervical carcinoma cells at low concentrations, with cytotoxicity blocked by excess unconjugated antibody, validating PLAP as a target.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Anti-PLAP ricin A chain conjugate at low concentrations showed 100-fold greater toxicity to PLAP-producing SKGIIIa cervical carcinoma cells than to HepG2 cells; specific cytotoxicity was inhibited by excess unconjugated anti-PLAP but not anti-AFP, confirming antigen-dependent killing.

title: Effects of ricin A chain conjugates of monoclonal antibodies to human alpha-fetoprotein and placental alkaline phosphatase on antigen-producing tumor cells in culture.

evidence_summary: Adenoviral-mediated E7 gene transfer to dendritic cells via CD40 targeting enhanced vaccine efficacy against HPV-16-induced tumors in mice, demonstrating antigen-specific, CD8+ T-cell-dependent protection and partial therapeutic immunity.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Dendritic cells infected with CD40-targeted adenoviral vector encoding HPV16 E7 enhanced protection against HPV-16-induced tumor cells in a murine model; protection was antigen-specific and CD8+ T-cell dependent.

title: Adenoviral vectors targeted to CD40 enhance the efficacy of dendritic cell-based vaccination against human papillomavirus 16-induced tumor cells in a murine model.

evidence_summary: Cloned pierisin cDNA, expressed the protein in vitro, and demonstrated apoptosis induction in human gastric carcinoma TMK-1 and cervical carcinoma HeLa cells; mutagenesis of Glu165 and ADP-ribosylation inhibitors abolished or reduced this activity, confirming functional apoptotic role.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Recombinant pierisin induced apoptosis in HeLa and TMK-1 cells; Glu165 substitution and ADP-ribosylation inhibitors greatly reduced cytotoxicity and apoptosis induction.

title: Molecular cloning of an apoptosis-inducing protein, pierisin, from cabbage butterfly: possible involvement of ADP-ribosylation in its activity.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

title: Different agglutinability of fibroblasts underlying various precursor lesions of human uterine cervical carcinoma.

evidence_summary: Western blot and in vitro translation identified HPV16 E6, E7, E4 proteins in CaSki and SiHa cells, and HPV18 E1 and E7 proteins in HeLa, C4-1, and SW756 cells, using antibodies raised against bacterially expressed fusion proteins.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Identified as an 11-kd protein in CaSki cell line by Western blot and in vitro translation of hybrid-selected RNA.
Identified as a 15-kd cytoplasmic protein in SiHa and CaSki cell lines by Western blot; most abundant protein in these cells.
Identified as a 10-kd protein in CaSki cell line by Western blot and in vitro translation of hybrid-selected RNA.
Identified as a 70-kd protein in HeLa cell line by Western blot and in vitro translation of hybrid-selected RNA.
Identified as a 12-kd cytoplasmic protein in HeLa, C4-1, and SW756 cell lines by Western blot; most abundant protein in these cells.

title: Identification of early proteins of the human papilloma viruses type 16 (HPV 16) and type 18 (HPV 18) in cervical carcinoma cells.

evidence_summary: E7 mutants lacking the LXCXE motif lost interaction with B-Myb, FoxM1, and LIN9, impairing cooperative transcriptional activation of mitotic genes in primary human fibroblasts; patient cervical lesion transcript correlations support in vivo relevance.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: E7 interacts with B-Myb, FoxM1, and LIN9 components of the B-Myb-MuvB complex via its LXCXE motif, leading to cooperative transcriptional activation of mitotic genes independently of pocket protein degradation.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: primary human fibroblasts, patient cervical lesions

title: A functional interaction of E7 with B-Myb-MuvB complex promotes acute cooperative transcriptional activation of both S- and M-phase genes. (129 c).

evidence_summary: Celecoxib treatment in cervical cancer patients up-regulated TCR-zeta expression in tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, measured by immunohistochemistry.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: After 10 days of celecoxib treatment, the percentage of TCR-zeta positive TIL significantly increased (P=0.0016) compared to baseline in cervical cancer patients.

title: Celecoxib up-regulates the expression of the zeta chain of T cell receptor complex in tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes in human cervical cancer.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Transgenic mice expressing wild-type or mutant HPV16 E6 were treated with estrogen to show that E6 synergizes with estrogen to induce cervical cancer, and that E6 interactions with cellular alpha-helix and PDZ partners correlate with carcinogenic activity; E6 induced E2F-responsive genes Mcm7 and cyclin E and prevented p16 expression via alpha-helix partners.
title: The human papillomavirus E6 oncogene dysregulates the cell cycle and contributes to cervical carcinogenesis through two independent activities.

validated_targets.specific_model_name: mice, multiple human cancer cell lines

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HDAC6 inhibition with Tubastatin-A or genetic knockdown blocked STIM1 translocation and store-operated Ca2+ entry specifically in cancer cells, reducing malignant behavior.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: cervical cancer cell lines, normal cervical epithelial cells, and patient surgical specimens

title: Microtubule-associated histone deacetylase 6 supports the calcium store sensor STIM1 in mediating malignant cell behaviors.

evidence_summary: Combination treatment with arsenic trioxide and docosahexaenoic acid significantly reduced viability, induced apoptosis, and increased intracellular lipid peroxidation in multiple arsenic trioxide-resistant solid tumor cell lines, with selective toxicity confirmed in normal cells.
title: Enhancement of arsenic trioxide-mediated apoptosis using docosahexaenoic acid in arsenic trioxide-resistant solid tumor cells.

evidence_summary: CDK9 inhibitor FIT-039 treatment suppressed HPV E6/E7 expression, restored p53 and pRb in cervical cancer cells, and inhibited xenograft tumor growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CDK9 inhibitor FIT-039 suppressed HPV E6/E7 expression, restored p53 and pRb, and repressed growth of HPV+ cervical cancer xenografts.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: HPV+ cervical cancer cells, HPV16+ xenografts, organotypic raft culture

title: CDK9 Inhibitor FIT-039 Suppresses Viral Oncogenes E6 and E7 and Has a Therapeutic Effect on HPV-Induced Neoplasia.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: In vitro coculture of cervical cancer-instructed dendritic cells and fibroblasts demonstrated IL23-mediated expansion of protumorigenic Th17 cells; mechanistic experiments showed cancer cell-derived IL6 suppresses IL12p35 and induces IL23 in fibroblast-primed mDCs via C/EBPβ-dependent IL1β production.

Cervical cancer cell-derived IL6 directly suppressed IL12p35 in mDCs and indirectly induced IL23 expression in fibroblast-primed mDCs via C/EBPβ/IL1β pathway.

IL1β induction via C/EBPβ was necessary for IL23 upregulation and subsequent Th17 cell expansion in dendritic cell-fibroblast cocultures.

title: Cervical Cancer-Instructed Stromal Fibroblasts Enhance IL23 Expression in Dendritic Cells to Support Expansion of Th17 Cells.

evidence_summary: siRNA silencing of ATG5 in UA-treated TC-1 cells reduced autophagy marker LC3II and increased cell survival; Atg5-/- MEF cells showed reduced LC3II and increased survival under UA treatment, confirming ATG5-dependent autophagic cell death.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: siRNA silencing of ATG5 reduced LC3II and increased survival of UA-treated TC-1 cells; Atg5 knockout MEF cells showed reduced LC3II and increased survival under UA treatment, indicating ATG5 is required for UA-induced autophagic cell death.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: TC-1 cervical cancer cells, Atg5-/- MEF

title: Ursolic acid promotes cancer cell death by inducing Atg5-dependent autophagy.

evidence_summary: siRNA silencing of Rac reduced fenretinide-induced ROS and apoptosis in HNSCC, lung, cervical cancer and murine melanoma cells; overexpression of constitutive active Rac mutant increased ROS and PARP cleavage, confirming Rac's role in apoptosis induction.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: siRNA knockdown or inhibition of Rac decreased fenretinide-induced ROS production and apoptosis; overexpression of constitutive active Rac mutant increased basal and fenretinide-induced ROS and PARP cleavage in HNSCC cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: UMSCC-22B (HNSCC), DM14 (metastatic HNSCC), Tu167-C2 (primary HNSCC), cervical cancer cells, lung cancer cells, murine melanoma cells

title: Involvement of Rac in fenretinide-induced apoptosis.

title: C-Jun N-terminal kinase is required for phorbol ester- and thapsigargin-induced apoptosis in the androgen responsive prostate cancer cell line LNCaP.

evidence_summary: Ursolic acid-mediated NF-kappaB inhibition sensitized cervical and lung cancer cells to Taxol/cisplatin via amplified intrinsic apoptosis pathway, validated in vitro and in mouse model.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Docetaxel induced TP53 RNA in A549 cells; siRNA-mediated TP53 knockdown in A549 increased docetaxel-induced beta-tubulin expression, demonstrating TP53 suppresses tubulin induction.

Docetaxel increased TUBB transcription and protein levels in TP53-null H1299 cells; TP53 knockdown in A549 enhanced TUBB induction, while TP53 overexpression suppressed it, revealing TUBB is induced in the absence of TP53.

title: Induction of tubulin by docetaxel is associated with p53 status in human non small cell lung cancer cell lines.

evidence_summary: Antisense knockdown of KITLG (Steel factor) in cervical carcinoma cell lines (CALO, INBL) and primary AML blasts reduced cell interaction and survival, demonstrating the importance of KITLG/KIT juxtacrine signaling in density-dependent growth.
disease: Cervical cancer and acute myeloid leukemia

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Antisense oligonucleotides targeting KITLG (Steel factor) in cervical carcinoma cell lines and primary AML blasts disrupted KITLG/KIT juxtacrine interaction, leading to reduced cell interaction and survival, confirming its role in density-dependent growth.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: CALO and INBL cervical carcinoma cell lines; primary AML blasts

title: Implication of tyrosine kinase receptor and steel factor in cell density-dependent growth in cervical cancers and leukemias.

evidence_summary: In vivo treatment with T-cell bispecific antibodies (CEA-TCB/CEA-4-1BBL or FOLR1-TCB) induced tumor regression and CD8+ T-cell infiltration in MKN-45 gastric and HeLa cervical xenograft models, which was monitored by 89Zr-Df-IAB22M2C PET imaging and validated by CD8-IHC.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: 89Zr-Df-IAB22M2C PET imaging detected intratumoral CD8+ T-cell infiltration after T-cell bispecific antibody treatment in MKN-45 and HeLa xenografts, confirmed by CD8 immunohistochemistry and gamma counting.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: MKN-45 gastric cancer cells, HeLa cervical cancer cells, humanized mice

title: The PET-Tracer <sup>89</sup>Zr-Df-IAB22M2C Enables Monitoring of Intratumoral CD8 T-cell Infiltrates in Tumor-Bearing Humanized Mice after T-cell Bispecific Antibody Treatment.

evidence_summary: Genetic and pharmacological neutrophil depletion in an autochthonous mouse model of soft tissue sarcoma improved tumor response to radiation therapy.
title: Neutrophils promote tumor resistance to radiation therapy.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: Curcumin treatment in HeLa cells suppressed AP-1 binding activity and HPV18 transcription, and reversed the tumor-associated c-Fos upregulation and Fra-1 downregulation to a normal expression pattern.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Curcumin treatment in HeLa cells downregulated c-Fos expression, reversing the cancer-associated overexpression.
Curcumin treatment in HeLa cells upregulated Fra-1 expression, reversing the cancer-associated downregulation.
Curcumin treatment reduced AP-1 DNA-binding activity in HeLa cells.

title: Constitutive activation of transcription factor AP-1 in cervical cancer and suppression of human papillomavirus (HPV) transcription and AP-1 activity in HeLa cells by curcumin.

evidence_summary: MG132 sensitized HeLa and SiHa cervical cancer cells to rhTRAIL-induced apoptosis; antagonist DR4 antibody partially inhibited apoptosis in HeLa; XIAP siRNA plus rhTRAIL induced high apoptosis in HeLa, requiring MG132 in SiHa, validating DR4 and XIAP involvement.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Antagonistic DR4 antibody partially inhibited rhTRAIL+MG132-induced apoptosis in HeLa cells.
XIAP siRNA combined with rhTRAIL induced high apoptosis in HeLa; in SiHa, MG132 was additionally required for apoptosis induction.

title: Proteasome inhibitor MG132 sensitizes HPV-positive human cervical cancer cells to rhTRAIL-induced apoptosis.

evidence_summary: Pharmacological inhibition of ketohexokinase decreased serum LPC levels and prevented fructose-enhanced tumour growth in mouse models of cervical cancer; co-culture experiments demonstrated hepatocyte-derived LPCs were consumed by cancer cells.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Pharmacological inhibition of ketohexokinase had no direct effect on cancer cells but decreased circulating LPC levels and prevented fructose-mediated tumour growth in vivo.

title: Dietary fructose enhances tumour growth indirectly via interorgan lipid transfer.

evidence_summary: In BALB/c mice, co-vaccination with rAAV-16L1 and rAd-mGM-CSF induced strong and prolonged neutralizing antibodies against HPV16, comparable to VLP vaccine; immunohistochemistry showed accumulation of antigen-presenting cells at the injection site.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Co-vaccination with rAAV-16L1 and rAd-mGM-CSF induced comparable high levels of neutralizing antibodies to VLP vaccine in BALB/c mice, demonstrating L1 as a protective antigen.

title: Co-vaccination with adeno-associated virus vectors encoding human papillomavirus 16 L1 proteins and adenovirus encoding murine GM-CSF can elicit strong and prolonged neutralizing antibody.

evidence_summary: siRNA-mediated ERK2 silencing in U2OS osteosarcoma cells reduced gp130 expression; luciferase reporter and mRNA stability assays confirmed ERK2-dependent transcriptional regulation; ERK2 binding to GP130 promoter was demonstrated.
disease: Osteosarcoma, breast, prostate, lung, cervical cancers

validated_targets.experimental_detail: siRNA knockdown of ERK2 (MAPK1) in U2OS cells inhibited gp130 expression; ERK2 binds to the GP130 promoter.
gp130 (IL6ST) expression was downregulated upon ERK2 silencing; luciferase reporter and mRNA stability assays confirmed transcriptional downregulation.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: U2OS osteosarcoma cells, breast, prostate, lung, cervical cancer cell lines

title: Control of gp130 expression by the mitogen-activated protein kinase ERK2.

evidence_summary: Bortezomib and thapsigargin exerted preferential cytotoxicity in hypoxic tumor cells via ER stress overactivation; genetic or pharmacologic autophagy ablation increased apoptosis, confirming autophagy as a protective mechanism.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Cycloheximide treatment relieved ER load and ameliorated enhanced cytotoxicity, confirming ER stress-dependence; ER stressors thapsigargin and bortezomib caused enhanced UPR activation in hypoxic cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: HeLa cervical carcinoma cells, DLD1 colorectal carcinoma cells, and in vivo UPR reporter models

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Pharmacologic or genetic ablation of autophagy in HeLa cells under hypoxia and bortezomib treatment increased levels of apoptosis, indicating autophagy acts as a protective mechanism against cell death.

title: Preferential cytotoxicity of bortezomib toward hypoxic tumor cells via overactivation of endoplasmic reticulum stress pathways.

evidence_summary: Reporter assays and cap-dependency experiments demonstrated that HPV-18 E6 translation requires the cap-binding protein eIF4E and the RNA helicase eIF4AI, and identified a conserved TILM motif regulating leaderless mRNA translation.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Translation of HPV-18 E6 mRNA was shown to require eIF4E via cap-dependent translation assays.
Translation of HPV-18 E6 mRNA was shown to require eIF4AI via cap-dependent translation assays.

title: High-risk human papillomavirus-18 uses an mRNA sequence to synthesize oncoprotein E6 in tumors.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: DETA-NO treatment in HPV-infected cervical cells increased HPV E6/E7 transcripts, decreased TP53 and RB1 protein levels, and induced DNA double-strand breaks and mutations.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: NO donor treatment significantly decreased p53 protein levels in HPV-infected cells.
NO donor treatment significantly decreased pRb protein levels in HPV-infected cells.
NO donor treatment increased E6 mRNA levels in cells maintaining episomal high-risk HPV genomes.
NO donor treatment increased E7 mRNA levels in cells maintaining episomal high-risk HPV genomes.

title: Nitric oxide induces early viral transcription coincident with increased DNA damage and mutation rates in human papillomavirus-infected cells.

evidence_summary: BPR0L075 treatment in KB cervical carcinoma cells caused G2/M arrest and apoptosis; tubulin binding and polymerization inhibition confirmed target engagement; cyclin B1 increase, Cdc2/Cdc25C phosphorylation, Bcl-2 phosphorylation, caspase-3 activation demonstrated; xenograft growth inhibition in nude mice.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: BPR0L075 bound to colchicine-binding site of tubulin and inhibited tubulin polymerization.
BPR0L075 treatment increased cyclin B1 levels in KB cells.
BPR0L075 caused mobility shift of Cdc2 (CDK1) indicating phosphorylation, associated with mitotic arrest.
BPR0L075 caused mobility shift of Cdc25C indicating phosphorylation.
BPR0L075 induced phosphorylation of Bcl-2 in KB cells.
Caspase-3 cascade was activated in BPR0L075-treated KB cells.

title: BPR0L075, a novel synthetic indole compound with antimitotic activity in human cancer cells, exerts effective antitumoral activity in vivo.

evidence_summary: Murine model of HPV+ HNSCC treated with PD-1 blockade and radiotherapy showed increased memory B cells, plasma cells, B-cell clonality, somatic hypermutation, and germinal center formation; human proteome array on serum from patients receiving PD-1 blockade demonstrated enhanced IgG and IgM antibody responses in those with clinical benefit.
title: B Cells Improve Overall Survival in HPV-Associated Squamous Cell Carcinomas and Are Activated by Radiation and PD-1 Blockade.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: E7-expressing human foreskin keratinocytes showed enhanced migration and cytoplasmic p27 retention via PI3K/Akt pathway; ROCK inhibitor treatment in control cells enhanced migration, mimicking E7 effect, validating RhoA/ROCK pathway's role.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: E7-expressing HFKs exhibited enhanced migration and cytoplasmic p27 retention in a PI3K/Akt-dependent manner.
The PI3K/Akt pathway was required for E7-induced migration enhancement and p27 cytoplasmic retention.
E7-expressing cells showed Akt-regulated downregulation of RhoA activity through p27 binding, and ROCK inhibition enhanced control cell migration, validating RhoA pathway involvement.
ROCK inhibitor treatment enhanced control cell migration but had little effect on E7-expressing cells, indicating that ROCK inhibition mimics E7 effect on migration.

title: The E7 protein from human papillomavirus type 16 enhances keratinocyte migration in an Akt-dependent manner.

evidence_summary: Proteasome inhibitors (bortezomib, epoxomicin, MG-132) induced FADD-dependent caspase-8 activation in Bcl-2-overexpressing HeLa cervical cancer cells, which required Atg5 and autophagy; XIAP depletion or antagonism switched the response to efficient apoptosis, demonstrating functional target validation via drug treatments, genetic depletion, Western blot, and enzymatic activity assays.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Proteasome inhibition induced FADD-dependent caspase-8 activation, which accounted for the major DEVDase activity in Bcl-2-overexpressing HeLa and H460 cells, bypassing the need for MOMP; caspase-8 processing was detected by Western blot.
Caspase-8 activation after proteasome inhibition required Atg5 and the induction of autophagy, as shown using Atg5-deficient mouse embryonic fibroblasts.

Depletion of XIAP or addition of XIAP-antagonising peptides in combination with proteasome inhibitors led to efficient apoptosis execution via the caspase-8/caspase-3 axis, demonstrating XIAP inhibition sensitizes resistant cells.

title: Proteasome inhibition can induce an autophagy-dependent apical activation of caspase-8.

evidence_summary: Ectopic expression of p300 or CBP rescued BRCA1-mediated inhibition of ER-alpha activity; p300 downregulation by BRCA1 correlated with ER-alpha repression in breast and prostate cancer cell lines.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: BRCA1 overexpression inhibited ER-alpha activity and downregulated p300 protein levels in breast and prostate cancer cell lines.
BRCA1 expression downregulated p300; ectopic p300 rescued BRCA1-mediated ER-alpha repression.
BRCA1 did not alter CBP levels; ectopic CBP similarly rescued ER-alpha activity, mapping to CH3 domain.

title: p300 Modulates the BRCA1 inhibition of estrogen receptor activity.

evidence_summary: Hypoxic culture of HPV-positive cancer cells led to E6/E7 repression without p53 increase, impaired mTOR signaling via DDIT4/TSC2 axis, and induction of reversible dormancy; mTOR impairment also interfered with senescence response to prosenescent chemotherapy in vitro.
disease: Cervical cancer and head and neck cancer

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Impaired mTOR signaling under hypoxia, or by inhibitor, induced reversible growth arrest and interfered with prosenescent chemotherapy response in HPV-positive cancer cells in vitro.

title: Induction of dormancy in hypoxic human papillomavirus-positive cancer cells.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: Overexpression of HR-HPV E7 and E6 in primary and immortalized human keratinocytes induced lnc-FANCI-2; YY1 interacted with E7 and transactivated the lnc-FANCI-2 promoter via YY1-binding motifs; HPV18 increased YY1 by reducing miR-29a, which targets YY1 3' UTR.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Upregulated in HR-HPV infection and cervical lesion progression; induced by E7 and YY1 in keratinocytes.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: CaSki cells, primary human keratinocytes, clinical cervical tissues

validated_targets.experimental_detail: YY1 interacts with E7 and transactivates lnc-FANCI-2 promoter; HPV18 upregulates YY1 by reducing miR-29a.
E7 from HR-HPV but not LR-HPV induces lnc-FANCI-2 in primary and immortalized human keratinocytes.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: primary human keratinocytes, immortalized human keratinocytes

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HPV18 reduces miR-29a, which targets YY1 3'UTR, leading to YY1 upregulation.

title: Oncogenic HPV promotes the expression of the long noncoding RNA lnc-FANCI-2 through E7 and YY1.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
